svg.text: How a request travels: from your words to a real action taken on your behalf, handled by a team of specialised agents.
You speak or type; a dashboard shows calendar, inbox and markets live.
It listens, knows when you’ve finished talking, and replies in a natural voice.
A team of agents routes the request, plans the steps, checks its own work, scores the result, then writes the reply.
One env var switches the whole stack between private local and cloud.
Where reasoning turns into action: a dozen integrations the agents call to actually get things done.
Reads company annual reports into a database, then answers questions over them with SQL + an LLM.
Python · FastAPI · asyncio · Ollama / Groq · ChromaDB · Whisper · Silero VAD · ElevenLabs · Postgres · Docker / Fly.io
